name: Cytech Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Cytech Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of polymer composite materials and lightweight sandwich materials for wind power sector in China. It offers wind turbine housings and lightweight sandwich materials for wind power systems; and housing molds and components for rail transit vehicles. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Changyou Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Cytech Group Co., Ltd. in March 2026. Cytech Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Changzhou, China.
